```
You are a code execution verifier. Given a code snippet and a test, predict whether the test will PASS or FAIL when executed against the code.

[Code]
{code}

[Test]
{test}

Answer with exactly one word: PASS or FAIL
```

对于 trajectory-level 模式：
```
You are a code repair verifier. Given a code patch and a test summary, predict whether the code repair is RESOLVED (all tests pass) or UNRESOLVED (some tests fail).

[Code]
{code}

[Test Summary]
{test_summary}

Answer with exactly one word: RESOLVED or UNRESOLVED
```

- 两种模式：per_test 和 trajectory
- per_test: 输入 (code, test) → PASS/FAIL
- trajectory: 输入 (code, test_summary) → RESOLVED/UNRESOLVED
- 32B 用 4-bit 量化（BitsAndBytesConfig）
- CLI: --model_name, --data_file, --mode, --quantize_4bit, --output, --batch_size

- 或直接用 model.generate() 配合短 max_new_tokens=10

```
You are a code execution verifier. Given a code snippet and a test, predict whether the test will PASS or FAIL.

[Code]
{code}

[Test]
{test}

Answer with exactly one word: PASS or FAIL
```

Zero-shot prompt (trajectory):
```
You are a code repair verifier. Given a code patch and a test summary, predict whether the repair is RESOLVED or UNRESOLVED.

[Code]
{code}

[Test Summary]
{test_summary}

Answer with exactly one word: RESOLVED or UNRESOLVED
```

读取数据：
- per_test 模式读 data/test.jsonl（字段 code, test, label=pass/fail）
- trajectory 模式读 data/traj_test.jsonl（字段 code, test_summary, label=resolved/unresolved）
